verses.1: He loves knowledge; he also loves wisdom. He prefers to be in the wilderness.
verses.2: He who pleases the Lord will receive what He desires, and he who is willing to serve will inherit.
verses.3: A wicked person shall not be accepted, nor shall those who are righteous be honored.
verses.4: She who is like a flock of sheep, but her husband is like a wild animal, shameless and contemptible.
verses.5: The thoughts of the righteous are based on justice, while the thoughts of the wicked are full of deceit.
verses.6: The words of the wicked are bloodshed; but the words of the righteous will save them.
verses.7: The wicked will be destroyed, but the houses of the righteous will stand firm.
verses.8: According to his wisdom, a man will be praised; but if his heart is evil, it will become a source of sorrow.
verses.9: Goodness is easy to find, and those who serve it are those who are not exhausted or lacking in strength.
verses.10: The righteous know the spirit of those who are dead, while the mercies of the wicked remain ungranted.
verses.11: He serves his land with devotion and loyalty; yet he is also a person who hates those who lack heart.
verses.12: The wicked will be punished, while the righteous will be rewarded.
verses.13: In the mouth of sin lies evil; it brings suffering and trouble upon itself. But a good person will be saved from such troubles.
verses.14: May the fruit of a man’s labor be good, and may God restore his hands to their former state.
verses.15: He walks in a righteous path, and he listens to wise advice.
verses.16: The lion will know his anger on that day, and he will be filled with sorrow.
verses.17: He will establish truth and speak righteousness; he will also expose lies and deceit.
verses.18: It contains words like “madkaro” and “charav”, as well as wise words that are soothing.
verses.19: The truthful word will always remain true, and it will never be distorted into falsehoods.
verses.20: Deceit in the hearts of those who are evil, and joy for those who are good.
verses.21: The righteous will not be harmed by all the evil deeds of the wicked.
verses.22: The LORD’s anger is upon those who speak lies and do what is dishonest.
verses.23: A foolish man is like a container filled with knowledge, but his heart is like that of a fool. He is called “foolish” by others.
verses.24: The hands of those who are cruel will be destroyed, and pride will become worthless.
verses.25: A worry in one’s heart brings joy, and good words bring happiness.
verses.26: The righteous will remain far from their enemies, while the paths of the wicked will be destroyed.
verses.27: Let not Remia’s side be harmed, and let man not suffer any harm.
verses.28: In the house of righteousness, they live; and their path leads to life.
